name: The Beach Boys

whyMatters.en: California group formed in 1961. Brian Wilson’s studio harmony and sectional recording peak on Pet Sounds (1966) and the single Good Vibrations.
whyMatters.zh: 加州组合，1961 年成立。Brian Wilson 的录音室和声与分段录音，高峰在 Pet Sounds（1966）与单曲 Good Vibrations。

lyricQuotes: God only knows what I'd be without you
Wouldn't it be nice if we were older

shortBio.en: Brian Wilson studio pop, California, 1961–. Pet Sounds and Good Vibrations are the main 1966 reference points.
shortBio.zh: Brian Wilson 录音室流行，加州，1961 年起。1966 年主要参照为 Pet Sounds 与 Good Vibrations。

body.en:
The Beach Boys formed in California in 1961 around the Wilson brothers, Mike Love, and Al Jardine. Early Capitol singles such as Surfin’ U.S.A. (1963) used surf themes, stacked vocals, and Chuck Berry–derived guitar figures.

Pet Sounds (1966) and Good Vibrations used session players, French horn, electro-theremin, bicycle bells, and sections recorded across multiple studios. The unfinished Smile sessions followed. Brian stepped back from touring after 1964; his densest studio period is roughly 1965–67.
body.zh:
The Beach Boys 于 1961 年在加州成立，核心为 Wilson 兄弟、Mike Love 与 Al Jardine。早期 Capitol 单曲如 Surfin’ U.S.A.（1963）使用冲浪题材、堆叠人声，以及源自 Chuck Berry 的吉他音型。

Pet Sounds（1966）与 Good Vibrations 使用 session 乐手、法国号、electro-theremin、自行车铃，并跨多家录音室分段录制。随后是未完成的 Smile 录音。Brian 于 1964 后退出现场巡演；录音室最密的时期约在 1965–67。

note.en: Early surf single. Chuck Berry–style guitar figure under stacked vocals.
note.zh: 早期冲浪单曲。Chuck Berry 式吉他音型加堆叠人声。

note.en: From Pet Sounds. Layered vocals and French horn.
note.zh: 出自 Pet Sounds。多层人声与法国号。

note.en: Capitol single. Sections recorded in multiple studios; electro-theremin hook.
note.zh: Capitol 单曲。多录音室分段录制；electro-theremin hook。

body.en:
Pet Sounds (1966) moved from surf singles to denser arrangement: Wouldn’t It Be Nice, God Only Knows, stacked Wilson vocals, and Los Angeles session players beside the band.

Good Vibrations assembled sections recorded across studios—electro-theremin, cello, vocal overlays. Brian Wilson’s production methods are the documented focus of that year.
body.zh:
Pet Sounds（1966）从冲浪单曲转向更密的编曲：Wouldn’t It Be Nice、God Only Knows、Wilson 堆叠人声，以及乐队外的洛杉矶 session 乐手。

Good Vibrations 跨录音室组装段落——electro-theremin、大提琴、人声叠层。Brian Wilson 的制作方法是该年有文献可查的重点。

title.en: Wilson brothers plus Love and Jardine
title.zh: Wilson 兄弟加 Love 与 Jardine

body.en:
Brian, Carl, and Dennis Wilson formed the family core; Mike Love and Al Jardine shared lead vocals on tour and record. Brian stopped regular live work after 1964; the studio peak is 1965–67.

The Smile sessions stalled. Pet Sounds and Good Vibrations remain the clearest completed work from that stretch before Brian’s withdrawal from daily band leadership.
body.zh:
Brian、Carl、Dennis Wilson 是家庭核心；Mike Love 与 Al Jardine 分担巡演与录音主唱。Brian 于 1964 年后不再常驻现场；录音室高峰在 1965–67。

Smile 录音中止。Pet Sounds 与 Good Vibrations 仍是 Brian 退出日常主导前，该阶段最完整的完成作品。

body.en:
The Beatles’ Revolver and Sgt. Pepper sessions document cross-listening with Pet Sounds. Later studio psychedelic acts, including Pink Floyd, used sectional recording and stacked vocals in related ways.

Early surf singles still carry Chuck Berry–style guitar figures; the lasting production traits are stacked harmony and multi-studio editing.
body.zh:
Beatles 的 Revolver 与 Sgt. Pepper 录音记录了与 Pet Sounds 的交叉聆听。后来的录音室迷幻乐队（包括 Pink Floyd）以相近方式使用分段录音与堆叠人声。

早期冲浪单曲仍带 Chuck Berry 式吉他音型；更持久的制作特征是堆叠和声与跨录音室剪辑。

body.en: 1963 Capitol single. Surf lyric over a Chuck Berry–derived guitar figure and stacked group vocals.
body.zh: 1963 年 Capitol 单曲。冲浪歌词，配合源自 Chuck Berry 的吉他音型与堆叠和声。
